document.notes: Five landscape pages, 10 classes. Every NC row shows only place 'NC', name, machine (if any) and the 0/1/2/3/5 counts; its marks, totals and Score are blank on the page but present in the PDF text layer as white text. The 'Pen.' column is printed but empty for every rider.

misfits.what: NC rows show only the place, name, machine and 0/1/2/3/5 counts; their marks, lap totals, day totals and Score are blank on the page but still in the PDF text layer as white text. standing.scores_public=false records that scores are withheld, but cannot say that the counts were published, nor that the file still carries the withheld values.
misfits.suggestion: Replace scores_public with a list of published fields (e.g. standing.published: ['counts']) and add document.hidden_content (boolean plus a note) so mappers can flag withheld-but-present data without copying it.

misfits.what: For some NC riders the only status (DNF or DNS) is in the hidden text layer; on the page the Score cell is blank. The protocol has no visibility qualifier on a status, so the hidden word can only go in an x_ key.
misfits.suggestion: Add an optional 'visibility' (shown | hidden-in-file) on totals and rows, or forbid hidden values outright in the guide.

misfits.what: Equal totals are separated with no printed reason; the countback is read off the printed mark counts. row.tie_break has no flag to say the rule was inferred.
Line colour is shown only as the fill of each class table header. class.colour holds the fill, but nothing on the sheet says it is the line ridden; no routes are encoded.
misfits.suggestion: Document whether class.colour means plate, line or display colour.

mapping.unread: Nothing unread. Values were read from the PDF text layer by position, using visible (black) text only. For every rider with visible marks, each lap's marks were checked against the printed lap total, the lap totals against the day total, the day totals plus Pen. against the Score, and the marks against the printed 0/1/2/3/5 counts; all agree. White text in rider rows (NC riders) was treated as hidden and not copied, except hidden status words noted in x_hidden_text_layer.
